constraints: Source-bound edit only: retain original slide geometry, shape order, relationship wiring, images, theme, and assets.
Exact text-binding cardinality and order are preserved; no paragraphs, runs, line breaks, or objects are added or removed.
Footer, legal line, and slide number remain source-bound.
Text fit and capacity are unmeasured. Do not infer supported capacity from source text.
Native rendering and visual qualification are separate gates; this contract is not adaptation-qualified.
